_meta.name: eta_probe_pack_p2v1v2
_meta.purpose: eta=C/V first-pass probe data: two verifier systems on the SAME frozen split, differing in architecture only. Per operational definitions in paper3-v1.1 sec:operational (C = utility-per-bit; V = path-coverage x accuracy x truth-grade).
_meta.probe_usage: v1 vs v2 are two points on the (C, V, latency, FLOPs) plane; utility gain (+22.3pt) vs description-length and compute cost is the existence question for eta's explanatory power.

systems.architecture: frozen bge-m3 embeddings + linear head (isomorphic baseline)

bits_estimate.note: task-specific bits vs pre-existing infra bits reported separately; C computed both ways (marginal and total).

latency.environment: CPU (8 threads) -- DEPLOYMENT-FAITHFUL (9876 daemon production class)
latency.note: MEASURED 2026-10-01, protocol mirrors v2 (60 singles + batch-149); head (<1ms) excluded. v2 runs on A100 bf16 = ITS deployment environment.

systems.flops_per_item_estimate: embedder (560M x 2 x seq_len) + head (~1.2M); seq_len=768 token cap

systems.params_total: 1.7B base (4-bit, pre-existing open weights) + 6.42M LoRA trainable

bits_estimate.note: task-specific adapter = 25.7MB; utility 88.51% sustained by it.

utility.u_states: 2/27 voluntary abstention on keyed rows (external protocol)

latency.note: MEASURED on A100-40G, bf16, seq<=768; per tools/hotpath eval 2026-10-01.

systems.flops_per_item_estimate: ~1.7e9 x 2 x n_tokens forward; n_tokens~600 typical
systems.training_cost: ~35 min on 4090-48G (3 epochs to best-dev, early-stopped ep5 of 8)

derived_points.interpretation: Marginal (task-specific bits) view: v2 spends 5.4x the task bits for 1.34x utility -> C_marginal DROPS. Total-infra view: v2 uses 0.385x the infra bits for 1.34x utility -> C_total RISES 3.5x. WHICH view is correct is a REAL question for eta's definition, not a bug: pre-existing open weights are effectively free infrastructure, same as bge-m3 is for v1.
derived_points.latency_note: MEASURED both: v1 CPU P50 404.7ms / 2.58 items/s vs v2 A100 P50 30.1ms / 118 items/s -> v2 is 13.4x faster (P50) and 45.9x (throughput) IN EACH SYSTEM'S OWN DEPLOYMENT ENVIRONMENT, while +22.3pt accuracy. Cross-hardware caveat: v1-on-A100 and v2-on-CPU unmeasured; the deployment-faithful pairing is the operationally meaningful one.

honest_gaps: FLOPs are parameter-count estimates, not profiler-verified
n=1 seed per system (split frozen; seed effect unquantified)
utility is single-metric (binary acc); ECE given as secondary
cross-hardware cells (v1-on-A100, v2-on-CPU) unmeasured; deployment-faithful pairing (v1=CPU daemon, v2=A100 hotpath) is what production actually runs
